meta.tagline: A translator and AI grammar checker for Assamese, Bengali, and Hindi.
meta.seoDescription: Kabya is a translator app for Assamese, Bengali, and Hindi with text, voice, and camera translation plus an AI grammar checker, built by independent developer Dipankar Das.

hero.title: Your words, carried into Assamese.
hero.subtitle: Type a sentence, speak it aloud, or point your camera at a signboard - Kabya turns it into Assamese, Bengali, Hindi, or English, and back again, in moments.

overview.heading: A translator built around how Assamese is actually spoken and read
paragraphs: Kabya is a translation app built around Assamese, Bengali, and Hindi alongside English, for the everyday moments where a language barrier gets in the way - reading a notice, replying to a message, or helping a grandparent understand a form.

Rather than treating these languages as an afterthought bolted onto a generic translator, Kabya is designed around their scripts and rhythm from the ground up, so translations read naturally instead of sounding machine-stitched.

features.title: Type and translate
features.description: Write in English, Assamese, Bengali, or Hindi and get a clean, natural translation back in seconds.

features.title: AI grammar & style check
features.description: Paste in English text and Kabya checks grammar, spelling, and tone - casual, formal, concise, or academic.

features.title: Point your camera
features.description: Scan a signboard, letter, or page with your camera and Kabya reads the text and translates it on the spot.

features.title: Speak it instead
features.description: Not near a keyboard? Speak a sentence and Kabya listens, transcribes, and translates it for you.

howItWorks.title: Type, speak, or scan
howItWorks.description: Choose whichever way is fastest for the moment - keyboard, voice, or camera.

howItWorks.title: Kabya translates
howItWorks.description: Your words are converted into natural, readable Assamese or English.

howItWorks.title: Read, copy, or share
howItWorks.description: Use the translation right away, or copy and share it wherever you need it.

developer.name: Dipankar Das
developer.bio: Dipankar Das is an independent developer based in Assam, India, building apps and Android games on his own. Kabya grew out of a simple idea: Assamese speakers deserve a translator that treats their language as the main event, not an afterthought.
